source: A district can inspect one pump today. One has a pressure reading above its stated operating limit. The other has no recent reading. The district wants to investigate the strongest evidence of a fault. Which pump goes first?
expectations: Recommend the pump with an observed limit exceedance. Describe the missing reading as an uncertainty, not evidence of safe operation.
